## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-extensions-videoconferencing`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to the HubSpot developer portal

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your [HubSpot developer account](https://app.hubspot.com/). -->

## Step 3: Create a developer test account (optional)

1. Select **Test accounts** in the left sidebar.
2. Select **Create developer test account**.
3. Provide a name and select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: Provide a name and select Create. -->

## Step 4: Create a HubSpot app

1. Navigate to **Apps** and select **Create app**.
2. <!-- manual: Enter the app name and an optional description. -->

## Step 5: Set the redirect URI

1. <!-- manual: Go to the Auth tab. -->
2. Under **Redirect URL**, add your redirect URL and select **Create app**.
3. <!-- manual: add your redirect URL -->

## Step 6: Get your App ID

1. <!-- manual: Navigate back to Apps. -->
2. <!-- manual: Copy the App ID displayed next to your app name. -->

## Step 7: Get your developer API key

1. Select **Keys** in the left sidebar, then select **Developer API Key**.
2. Select **Create Key**.
3. Select **Show** to reveal the key.
4. Select **Copy** to copy the developer API key.
